The [[Chest of Kathandrax]] will spawn after defeating [[Ilsundur, Lord of Fire]] in the final level of the [[Catacombs of Kathandrax]] dungeon. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive a [[Hammer of Kathandrax]] and one other item from the drop list in normal mode (2 in hard mode). After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and players will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.
